funFacts: Some fish communicate by farting — herring release bubbles from their swim bladders.
Some fish can change sex during their lifetime — clownfish are born male and can become female.
Electric eels can generate shocks up to 600 volts.
The Greenland shark can live over 400 years, the longest-living vertebrate.
